output.title: Spacious 4-Bedroom Semi-Detached House with South-Facing Garden in Bertrange
output.description:
This well-maintained semi-detached residence, built in the 1990s, offers approximately 195 m² of living space across multiple levels. The brick facade and small front garden enhance its traditional Luxembourg suburban character, while a private driveway provides convenient off-street parking. 

Inside, the living room features a functional open-plan design, combining living and dining areas with tile flooring and a fireplace. Double doors lead directly to the south-facing rear garden, creating an inviting transition between indoor and outdoor living spaces. 

The kitchen presents a warm, family-style atmosphere with wood cabinetry, a tile splashback, and a freestanding range, complemented by a breakfast nook ideal for informal meals. 

The property includes four bedrooms and two bathrooms, providing ample space for varied uses. Outdoor amenities comprise a private patio and a south-facing garden with a well-kept lawn, enhancing the quiet residential environment. Additionally, a cellar offers practical storage capacity. 

Located in Bertrange, a suburban commune west of Luxembourg City, the area is known for its residential setting with access to premium shopping at Belle Étoile, established schools, and tram connections via Cloche d'Or, supporting convenient regional mobility.
